ActorTalk: I used to be able to take a round or two off you at least, but now I can't beat you even once...
Sigh... I should just play dirty next time.
I heard it.
I just got lucky.
Hearing something and being able to see through it are two different things, haha.
Being too modest isn't a good habit either, you know, 【kuroname】.
Jokes aside—you've won. As the winner, you can make one request of me, just as we agreed.
I'm curious what you wanted to ask for originally.
I want you to let me tag along the next time you're doing something big.
Huh?
What do you mean?
You've all done so many incredible things on the front lines recently. Everyone respects you.
But me? I'm never there when it matters.
You have other missions, don't you?
Do you want to be respected?
Other missions are certainly important, but... 【kuroname】, we're classmates, and that's even more important. Don't leave me behind.
Everyone wants to be respected, but more than that... 【kuroname】, we're classmates. Don't leave me behind.
Things are only going to get more dangerous from here. I want to fight alongside you too.
...I've decided on my request.
What is it?
Beat me the next time we compete.
You want me to beat you first before making my request, huh? Sure! I won't lose next time!
